original_title: Investigators find no evidence of engine failure in fiery crash of skydiving plane that killed 12 - The Seattle Times

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: A skydiving plane crashed, killing 12 people. Investigators found no evidence of engine failure, suggesting other potential causes such as human error, maintenance issues, or external factors.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Investigations will continue to determine the cause of the crash. There may be increased scrutiny of skydiving operations and aircraft maintenance in the short term.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The incident may lead to changes in regulations or safety protocols for skydiving operations, potentially impacting the aviation industry as a whole.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: The crash may affect the operations of skydiving companies and airports, potentially leading to increased security measures, inspections, or restrictions on certain types of flights.
